description: Compute what one year at the Sportal IMPACT Campus actually costs, in INR: tuition for a named programme, plus optional hostel (accommodation, food and laundry), plus the one-time charges that apply in the first year only. Use this instead of adding the published figures yourself — the first year costs more than every year after it, which is the most common surprise in an Indian fee structure. Returns a full breakdown, never a bare number.

first_year.description: True to include the one-time admission charges, which apply in year one only. Defaults to true.

hostel.description: Hostel tier: 'quad' (four-sharing), 'twin' (twin-sharing), or 'none' to live off campus. Defaults to 'none'.

programme.description: Programme fee key or name, e.g. 'bpes', 'bsm', or 'Bachelor of Sports Management'. Get valid keys from list_programmes.

name: calculate_total_annual_fee
